findings: Current PER and Course Guide PDFs and curriculum visible text match the prior reviewed sources. The 125/130 core EC, 5/10 EC multidisciplinary project and 40/45 elective EC conflict persists. Current Committee Rules Article 1.3 and the regulations index provide no specific amendment or precedence that reconciles these credits. The public course URL yielded an app shell. Preserve the supported 130 EC subset and independent rules; a complete 180 EC pathway remains unverified.

PER Article 3.4/table (pp21–23) specifies 125 core EC, 7P1B30 at 5 EC and 7A2B30 at 10 EC. Article 3.4(8) requires at least 45 elective EC, while Appendix 2 specifies 40 (15 in Year 2 and 25 in Year 3). The retained diagnostic totals 175 EC (125 core + 10 ITEC + 40 electives), with years 60/60/55. The Course Guide (pp12–13) instead specifies both Year 3 projects at 10 EC and 130 core + 10 ITEC + 40 electives = 180 EC. Neither a two-quarter span nor two separately graded parts establishes a 5+5 core/elective split.

Appendix 3 requires 45 EC at level 3 overall and at least 30 elective EC at levels 2/3, including 5 EC at level 3. Its stated changes concern levels, without reconciling the project weight or total elective volume. Dutch and English numerical requirements share the conflict; no language precedence resolves it.

The current regulations index links the after-revision 2026–2027 PER separately from before-revision cohorts and the current Examination Committee Regulations. No linked credit amendment or reconciliation was found. Article 1.3 committee powers operate within the PER framework; they do not themselves amend 7P1B30 or reconcile 40/45 elective EC. No individual board approval or exemption is assumed.

The official research-portal result identifies the public 2026 Osiris course URL. Direct retrieval returned an app shell without course-credit data. Observed public client assets were read statically; no app execution, browser, login or authentication was used. Portal HTTP 403 and the app shell are access facts, separate from the unresolved academic contradiction.

Approval of 180 EC planned after 90 earned, nonoverlap, change reapproval, BSA 45/60 and noncredit SG/MyFuture rules remain valid. No exceptional permission is assumed.
